title: A meal from start to finish

sections.title: What you say, in order
sections.content: A restaurant visit has a fixed order, and you now have a phrase for each step: book (*Asztalt kell foglalni.*), ask for the menu (*Kérem az étlapot.*), order (*Kérnék egy levest és egy főételt.*), give a reason if needed (*Nem kérek húst, mert vegetáriánus vagyok.*), ask for the bill (*Kérem a számlát.*) and pay (*Fizetek.*).

sections.title: The steps
rows: One has to book a table.

items.english: What would you like to eat?

items.spanish: Egy levest és egy halat kérnék.
items.english: I'd like a soup and a fish.
Would you like a dessert too?
No, thank you. I'd like the bill.

sections.content: Keep the endings straight: a dish you ask for is *egy levest* with *kérek / kérnék*; a dish you know or point at is *a levest* or *ezt* with *kérem*.
